description: React component for the right-hand side channel info panel in Mattermost, including UI elements for channel details, actions, and modals.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of the channel.

methods.name: toggleMute
methods.description: Toggles the mute status of the channel.

methods.name: addPeople
methods.description: Opens modal to add people to the channel or DM.

methods.name: editChannelPurpose
methods.description: Opens modal to edit the channel's purpose.

methods.name: editChannelHeader
methods.description: Opens modal to edit the channel's header.

methods.name: editChannelName
methods.description: Opens modal to rename the channel.

methods.name: openNotificationSettings
methods.description: Opens modal to adjust notification settings.

methods.name: openUnarchiveChannel
methods.description: Opens modal to unarchive the channel.
